operator_convention.laplacian: Delta_1 alpha = -g^{ij} nabla_i nabla_j alpha + Ric(alpha)
operator_convention.this_block_only: principal second-symbol block from the second variation of -g^{ij} partial_i partial_j / -g^{ij} nabla_i nabla_j before connection, Ricci, projector, Hilbert, and local terms
not_included_here: delta Gamma and delta2 Gamma terms

ambient_metric_path.map: F_eps(x)=(I+eps A)x, A=A^T, x in S3 subset R4, descended to L(2,1)
ambient_metric_path.metric: g_eps = F_eps^* <.,.>_R4 on the fixed S3/RP3 parameter manifold
ambient_metric_path.reason: This is the same first ambient strain route that supplies P02=Sym^2(R4)=1+9 in earlier audits.

metric_derivatives.mixed_second_derivative_A_B: partial_A partial_B g(u,v)=<A u,B v>+<B u,A v>

inverse_metric_variation_formula.mixed_second: partial_A partial_B g^{ij} = h_A^{i}{}_k h_B^{kj} + h_B^{i}{}_k h_A^{kj} - k_{AB}^{ij}

definitions.k_AB: partial_A partial_B g, with k_AB(u,v)=<A u,B v>+<B u,A v>
definitions.raising: indices are raised with the epsilon=0 round metric on S3/RP3

principal_second_symbol.mixed_AB: delta2_principal_AB(Delta_1) alpha = - (partial_A partial_B g^{ij}) nabla_i nabla_j alpha
principal_second_symbol.expanded: = - (h_A^i_k h_B^{kj} + h_B^i_k h_A^{kj} - k_AB^{ij}) nabla_i nabla_j alpha
principal_second_symbol.same_A: d2_principal_AA(Delta_1) alpha = - (d2 g^{ij}/d eps^2) nabla_i nabla_j alpha, with d2 g^{-1}=2 h_A^2 - k_AA in raised-index notation
principal_second_symbol.sign_warning: This is only the principal second-symbol sign. Connection terms generated by differentiating covariant derivatives are separate and can change the full operator contribution.

pass_fail.meaning: The principal second-symbol formula and sign are fixed on the ambient path.
No C_delta2[1,1] or C_delta2[3,3] trace has been computed from this formula.
This formula alone cannot decide locality, cancellation, or C6 status.

plain_language: One gear of the fifth extinguisher is now shaped: the second inverse-metric piece. It is still sitting on the table; it has not been installed into the full machine.
verdict: The principal second-symbol part of delta2 Delta_1 is fixed at formula level on the ambient pullback path: delta2_principal_AB = -(partial_A partial_B g^{ij}) nabla_i nabla_j, with partial_A partial_B g^{-1}=h_A h_B+h_B h_A-k_AB. This closes only the formula-level sign gate for one subblock. The diagonal low-shell traces and all non-principal second-order terms remain open.
